title: Exam form submission
text: Semester exam forms must be filled online on the college portal between 1 and 15 November 2026. Late forms are accepted until 20 November with a fine of Rs 500.

title: Scholarship application
text: The state post-matric scholarship form is open until 30 November 2026. Required documents: income certificate, Aadhaar, previous marksheet, bank passbook copy. Submit at Room 12, Accounts Office, 10 am to 4 pm.

title: Fee payment
text: Semester fee can be paid online or at the bank counter by 10 November 2026. Fee in instalments is allowed only with a written request to the Principal.

title: Hostel allotment
text: Hostel forms are available at the warden office. Last date is 25 October 2026. The merit list will be put up on 2 November 2026.

title: ID card and bonafide certificate
text: New ID cards are issued at the Admin Office in 3 working days. A bonafide certificate needs a form signed by the class coordinator and takes 2 working days.

title: Re-evaluation
text: Re-evaluation requests must be made within 7 days of result declaration. Fee is Rs 300 per paper. Apply on the exam portal under Re-evaluation.

title: Library
text: Library is open 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday. Each student can borrow 3 books for 14 days. Late fine is Rs 2 per day.
